cart/data.description: Triggered when cart data is available or changes. This event carries the full cart state including items, totals, and applied discounts. External code can emit this event to update the cart programmatically or subscribe to it to react to cart changes.

cart/initialized.description: Emitted after the Cart drop-in completes its initialization sequence. This event signals that the cart is ready to accept user interactions and process cart operations.

cart/updated.description: Triggered when the cart state is updated, such as when quantities change, items are added or removed, or discounts are applied. Both the drop-in and external code can emit or listen to this event to maintain cart state synchronization.

cart/product/added.description: Emitted when a new product is added to the cart. Contains details about the added product including SKU, quantity, and selected options.

cart/product/removed.description: Emitted when a product is removed from the cart. Contains information about the removed item to allow tracking and analytics integration.

cart/product/updated.description: Emitted when an existing cart item is modified, such as when its quantity is changed or product options are updated.

cart/merged.description: Triggered when two cart instances are merged, typically occurring when a guest user logs in and their guest cart is merged with their authenticated cart. This event allows external code to respond to cart consolidation scenarios.

cart/reset.description: Triggered when the cart is reset to its initial empty state. This can occur after a successful checkout, when switching storefronts, or when explicitly cleared by user action or external code.

shipping/estimate.description: Triggered when a shipping cost estimate is calculated based on the destination address and selected shipping method. Both the drop-in and external integrations can emit or consume this event to coordinate shipping calculations across the storefront.
